- heading "Data Processing Systems Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites" [level=2]
- heading "Darmstadt, Germany" [level=2]
- paragraph: EUMETSAT is Europe’s meteorological satellite agency - monitoring the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- paragraph: Within the Data Processing Systems Engineering Competence Area (DP S&A) of the Satellite System Ground Segments Division (SGS) Division, the Data Processing Systems Engineers support the design, development/upgrade, verification and validation of Data Processing systems including the associated procurements and support their maintenance and evolutions during the operations phase. For the first years, the post holder is expected to primarily contribute to the transition of the new missions from development to operations.
- paragraph: You will work in an environment led by innovation and excellence. Joining EUMETSAT will give an unpaired opportunity to develop your professional path in satellite data processing.
- paragraph: We are seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented person to join our dynamic team as a key player in driving our organization’s growth and success. If you are a collaborative team player with a proven track record of driving results and are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role.
- heading "What you’ll be doing" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Define and maintain requirements and specifications in support to the development of new Data Processing systems or for upgrades to existing systems;
  - listitem: Contribute and follow-up the related developments/procurements and their integration into full scale Data Processing Systems and/or Ground Segments;
  - listitem: Contribute to the definition of, execution and follow up of Integration and Verification & Validation (IV&V) testing of new or evolved Data Processing Systems and Applications;
  - listitem: Support the scheduling and prioritisation of tasks, and the assessment of the adequacy of deliverables from other teams, organisations or industrial suppliers;
  - listitem: Contribute to the definition, planning and execution of the transition and handover of Data Processing Systems from the development phase to routine maintenance and operations;
  - listitem: Support the Data Processing Systems and Applications Competence Area Manager in defining long term plans and roadmaps to harmonise engineering, maintenance and evolutions of Data Processing Systems across all satellite systems exploited by EUMETSAT.
- heading "What we offer" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem:
    - text: Excellent salary, of up to Euro 8,500
    - strong: NET (after tax)
    - text: based on skills and experience;
  - listitem: Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave;
  - listitem: Full medical coverage for employee and family;
  - listitem: Attractive pension;
  - listitem: 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays;
  - listitem: Training and development support;
  - listitem: Relocation allowance and support (if applicable).
- heading "Requirements" [level=3]
- heading "Qualifications:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: A university degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering or another relevant discipline.
- heading "Skills and Experience:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Proven experience in engineering of Data Processing systems following well established processes, covering the full development lifecycle and relevant technical standards (e.g. ECSS, CCSDS, OGC);
  - listitem: Demonstrable knowledge of software development lifecycles and change control processes;
  - listitem: Competence in the area of Data Processing Systems Integration, Verification &Validation (IV&V) activities, including automated testing, software testing, unit test suite maintenance, software debugging and profiling;
  - listitem: Ability to manage complex tasks with minimum supervision, including planning and prioritisation of activities, allocation and coordination of resources, monitoring and reporting;
  - listitem: Good interpersonal and communication skills with proven ability to apply these to a team environment while working within a matrix structure;
  - listitem: Experience leading/coordinating engineering teams and in the management of industrial contracts in relevant area will be considered an advantage.
- paragraph:
  - strong: APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH
  - text: . WE WILL BE UNABLE TO CONSIDER APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED IN OTHER LANGUAGES.
- paragraph: EUMETSAT is an international organisation employing staff from across all 30 member states and this role is being advertised on multiple international job boards, but please note that this role would be based in Darmstadt, Germany and would require international applicants to relocate if successful. Remote working is not an option for this role.
- heading "More about us" [level=3]
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT’s role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide.
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT also operates several Copernicus missions on behalf of the European Union and provide data services to the Copernicus marine and atmospheric services and their users.
- paragraph:
  - strong: As an intergovernmental European Organisation, EUMETSAT can recruit nationals only from the 30 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom).

  - listitem: Proven and solid experience in engineering processes for managing requirements from the definition phase through the maintenance phase, including traceability, verification and validation using formal methods and tools (e.g. DOORs, Dimensions);
  - listitem: Competence in the area of Data Processing Systems Verification & Validation (V&V) activities, including automated testing, software testing, unit test suite maintenance, software debugging and profiling;

  - link "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites" [e12]:
    - /url: /job/track_click?job_id=296784
    - img "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites"
- heading "Quality Assurance Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites" [level=2]
- heading "Darmstadt, Germany" [level=2]
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT is Europe’s meteorological satellite agency - monitoring the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- paragraph: This is your chance to contribute to a world leading earth observation programme, set to generate global weather forecasting and climate monitoring benefits. As a Quality Assurance Engineer you will be at the heart of ensuring all elements of this complex system work together to deliver world leading meteorological products.
- paragraph: In the EUMETSAT matrix organisation, the Technical and Scientific Support (TSS) department provides support to the development and operations of EUMETSAT satellite systems, in particular ground systems, as well as quality assurance and management support services to the full organisation, through its Process Assurance and Management Support Division (PRS).
- paragraph: The selected Quality Assurance Engineer will be part of the TSS Quality Assurance team and closely collaborate with the engineering and scientific teams in TSS. She/he will be a member of TSS-led engineering development projects and will provide support to the maintenance and evolution of EUMETSAT operational systems and services and to other engineering-related activities adopting new technologies in line with the organisation’s multi-mission approach.
- heading "Duties" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Provide quality and product assurance for the maintenance and evolution of operational ground systems and support services, including organisation of reviews and management and follow up of technical investigations;
  - listitem: Define and ensure applicability of Quality and Product Assurance requirements for technical/engineering support contracts and monitor their implementation, including reporting and acting upon detected deviations, anomalies and non-conformities;
  - listitem: Plan and perform project quality assurance activities in support to project management, including the definition and tailoring of the applicable Quality and Product Assurance requirements, organisation of reviews and provision of key project quality indicators, identifying non-conformities with regards to the applicable processes and facilitating the project risk management process;
  - listitem: Provide Quality and Product Assurance support in acceptance processes (e.g. Incoming Inspections), tests related reviews (e.g. Test Readiness Review/Test Review Board), acceptance related reviews, management of anomalies, etc.);
  - listitem: Provide Product Assurance support to the Ground Segment System, Software and IT Infrastructure components, including the provision of expert support in the review of related deliveries and during technical investigations and milestones;
  - listitem: Define, analyse, and improve Quality Assurance processes of relevance to the TSS engineering activities, development projects and operations support services;
  - listitem: Monitor the effective implementation of QA processes and requirements, and reporting on any relevant findings, gaps and issues;
  - listitem: Participate in Internal Quality Audits and Quality Audits on external contractors/suppliers as necessary, to ensure their established processes are appropriate to fulfil the contracts they hold with EUMETSAT, in line with EUMETSAT requirements;
  - listitem: Support the harmonisation and standardisation of organisational processes for all QA aspects, contributing to their continual improvement;
  - listitem: Ensure lessons learnt in TSS projects are gathered, assessed, recorded and implemented/applied as relevant to subsequent projects;
  - listitem: Provide Quality and Product Assurance training to TSS personnel.
- heading "What we offer" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Generous salary, of up to Euro 8,500/month NET (after income tax) based on skills and experience;
  - listitem: Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave;
  - listitem: Excellent medical coverage for employee and family;
  - listitem: Attractive pension;
  - listitem: 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays;
  - listitem: Training and development support;
  - listitem: Relocation allowance and support (if applicable).
- heading "Requirements" [level=3]
- heading "Skills and Experience:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: "A minimum of five years experience in working with large-scale software-intensive systems in at least one of the following disciplines: Quality Assurance, Product Assurance or Software Engineering and general understanding of the others;"
  - listitem: Proven professional experience of working as part of the Engineering team or the Product Assurance team, in projects developing Software Systems, including its Software and IT Infrastructure components;
  - listitem: Experience in Ground Segment Systems and/or software QA/PA would be an advantage;
  - listitem: Experience readily applicable to the space domain will be an advantage (e.g. experience in aeronautical, defence, telecommunication or automotive engineering domains facing similar challenges and relying on related technologies and methodologies);
  - listitem: Knowledge of system engineering standards and methodologies in aspects relevant to space operational systems;
  - listitem: Experience in the definition and assessment of processes, good practices and/or standards in the field of quality assurance, combined with good knowledge and practice of the ISO 9001 and/or other relevant QA standards;
  - listitem: Experience with new technologies such as cloud computing and Docker/Kubernetes and development methodologies (e.g. Agile, DevOps) will be an advantage;
  - listitem: Excellent analysis, synthesis and presentation skills;
  - listitem: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to apply these to interactions within and between teams.
- heading "Qualifications:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: A university degree in engineering or computer science (or another relevant discipline);
  - listitem: Certification in quality assurance, management or auditing would be an advantage.
- heading "More about us" [level=3]
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT’s role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide.

- heading "Senior Software IV/QA Engineer - Test Automation" [level=2]
- heading "Thales" [level=2]
- heading "Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg" [level=2]
- heading "What we can do together:" [level=3]
- paragraph: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software IV/QA Engineer to strengthen software verification and test automation across our products and projects. You will define and implement test automation approaches that improve verification efficiency, software quality, and confidence throughout the development lifecycle. You will work across digital applications, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and edge environments, acting as a technical reference for automated verification and software testability.
- heading "Your responsibilities will include:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Define test automation strategies based on product risks, verification objectives, technical constraints, and expected value.
  - listitem: Design and maintain reusable automation frameworks and test solutions across applications, services, APIs, platforms, and distributed systems.
  - listitem: Integrate automated verification into the software delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines and representative test environments.
  - listitem: Work with software architects and engineering teams to improve system testability and enable efficient verification throughout the product lifecycle.
  - listitem: Analyze test results and complex failures, perform root-cause analysis, and support engineering teams in identifying product, test, or environment issues.
  - listitem: Assess the effectiveness of test automation and continuously improve coverage, reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
  - listitem: Work with the Cybersecurity Authority and engineering teams to integrate appropriate automated security verification into the software delivery lifecycle.
  - listitem: Provide technical leadership during projects, bids, customer discussions, and technical reviews on verification and validation activities, while promoting test automation practices and industry standards.
  - listitem: Maintain the technical documentation and verification evidence required to support automation strategies, frameworks, test environments, traceability, and their evolution.
- heading "About you:" [level=3]
- paragraph: We are looking for an engineer with significant experience in software verification, testing, and test automation.
- heading "Specifically, you should have:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Min.7 years of experience in software testing, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience in test automation.
  - listitem: Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation principles, including risk-based testing and defect management.
  - listitem: Proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining reusable test automation frameworks for complex software systems.
  - listitem: Experience automating verification across web applications, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and edge environments.
  - listitem: Proficiency in Python for test development and automation; experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Rust is a plus.
  - listitem: Good understanding of APIs, messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed system behavior.
  - listitem: Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and containerized or cloud-native environments.
  - listitem: Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across application, platform, and test environment layers.
  - listitem: Ability to assess where automation provides value and select the appropriate verification approach.
  - listitem: Strong technical leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to develop test automation practices across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  - listitem: ISTQB certification or an equivalent recognized software-testing qualification.
- heading "Additional skills and experience in any of the following topics would be highly valued:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Testing software used in space operations, ground segments, satellite data processing, or on-board systems or adjacent industries.
  - listitem: Advanced testing of federated or Kubernetes-based platforms and their infrastructure services.
  - listitem: Embedded software testing, hardware-software integration, Software-in-the-Loop, Hardware-in-the-Loop, simulators, or emulators.
  - listitem: Verification of complex mathematical models, signal processing algorithms, or physics-based simulations.
  - listitem: Performance, resilience, fault-injection, recovery, or degraded-mode testing.
  - listitem: Experience working in regulated, safety-critical, or high-assurance environments such as aerospace, automotive, or nuclear systems.
  - listitem: Software engineering and verification standards used in space or comparable mission-critical environments, such as ECSS.
  - listitem: We are looking for skilled and ambitious people as we continue to build our team and create a positive, diverse, and collaborative work environment.

- heading "About the Role" [level=3]
- paragraph: This is a unique opportunity to join Infront in a newly created Head of QA role and build a modern Quality Engineering function from the ground up. Operating in a fintech environment focused on financial markets and wealth technology, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with leadership to drive an automation-first approach to quality across the organisation. Working closely with Engineering, Product, and development teams, you'll shape strategy, implement scalable testing practices, and make a lasting impact on how software is built and delivered across the business.
- heading "Responsibilities" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Define and drive the quality engineering strategy across Infront;
  - listitem: Increase automated testing coverage across products and platforms;
  - listitem: Support teams in embedding testing into CI/CD pipelines and day-to-day development;
  - listitem: Contribute hands-on to automation frameworks, tooling, and technical quality initiatives where needed;
  - listitem: Lead and develop QA engineers and SDETs;
  - listitem: Support hiring and growth of quality engineering capability;
  - listitem: Establish standards and best practices for testing and quality engineering;
  - listitem: Work closely with engineering and product leadership to improve delivery quality and release confidence;
  - listitem: Drive practical improvements to quality processes, tooling, and engineering practices.
- heading "Who you are" [level=3]
- heading "Qualifications & Experience" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Strong background as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) or similar hands-on quality engineering role;
  - listitem: Proven experience leading QA transformations from manual testing to scalable automated testing frameworks;
  - listitem: Experience building and scaling automated testing frameworks;
  - listitem: Experience leading QA or quality engineering teams;
  - listitem: Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD and automated testing;
  - listitem: Experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders;
  - listitem: Strong communication and collaboration skills;
  - listitem: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

- heading "Senior Test Lead" [level=2]
- heading "Ford Motor Company" [level=2]
- heading "Madrid, Spain" [level=2]
- heading "Job Description" [level=3]
- paragraph: In this hands-on, influential role, you will design scalable automation across the full testing pyramid and help engineering teams use AI-assisted tooling where it delivers genuine value.
- heading "The role" [level=4]
- paragraph: You will architect and evolve enterprise-level test automation across unit, contract, integration, API, UI and selective end-to-end testing. Working primarily with Java, TypeScript, Selenium and Playwright, you will embed fast, reliable quality signals throughout the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipeline.
- heading "Responsibilities" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: "Build and evolve frameworks: Design maintainable, reusable and scalable test automation frameworks in Java and TypeScript."
  - listitem: "Strengthen the testing pyramid: Promote strong unit-test discipline and create contract, service-level integration, API and high-value end-to-end coverage."
  - listitem: "Improve UI and E2E quality: Build low-flake Selenium and Playwright suites, including visual regression and practical self-healing approaches."
  - listitem: "Integrate quality into delivery: Embed automated testing into CI/CD so teams receive useful quality signals in minutes, not days."
  - listitem: "Manage test data responsibly: Support data provisioning, masking, refresh and synthetic-data strategies in line with GDPR."
  - listitem: "Optimise and troubleshoot: Improve test speed and reliability, investigate failures and resolve automation issues quickly."
  - listitem: "Turn results into insight: Create reporting that highlights trends, risks and release readiness, not only pass/fail counts."
  - listitem: "Evaluate new tooling: Assess AI-assisted testing and development tools honestly, adopt what works at scale and explain their value and limitations to stakeholders."
- heading "Qualifications" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Strong experience of software-testing experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on test automation.
  - listitem: Strong Java skills, including collections, streams, REST clients and Maven or Gradle.
  - listitem: Strong TypeScript/JavaScript skills, including ES6+ and Node-based test tooling.
  - listitem: Hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright and Rest Assured, plus testing web services, web UI and REST APIs.
  - listitem: Proven experience designing enterprise-level automation frameworks, ideally in a regulated environment.
  - listitem: Practical experience across integration/contract and E2E testing, with a clear understanding of how these layers relate to unit coverage.
  - listitem: Experience with SQL, synthetic test-data generation, Git workflows and CI tooling.
  - listitem: Strong testing fundamentals, including equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, negative testing and risk-based prioritisation.
  - listitem: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
  - listitem: Practical exposure to AI-assisted testing or development tools such as Copilot, Cursor or LLM-based test generation.
  - listitem: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- heading "Nice to have" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Financial services, automotive finance or another regulated industry.
  - listitem: Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation.
  - listitem: Google Cloud and Cloud Build.
  - listitem: Performance testing with k6 or JMeter.
  - listitem: Security and compliance tooling such as OWASP ZAP, FOSSA or Cycode.
  - listitem: Knowledge of GDPR and security requirements for test data.

- heading "Senior Software Quality Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "Medtronic" [level=2]
- heading "London, United Kingdom" [level=2]
- heading "A Day in the Life" [level=3]
- paragraph: Medtronic, a global leader in medical technology, services, and solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Quality Engineer to join our innovative team. This role will be in the surgical operating unit within the new product development quality team.
- paragraph: The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for supporting software quality activities throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure products are safe, effective, reliable, and compliant with applicable standards and internal procedures. This role works closely with software engineering, systems engineering, regulatory, and quality teams to drive design quality, risk management, verification and validation, documentation quality, and continuous improvement.
- heading "Primary Responsibilities" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Support software quality activities across the full lifecycle, from requirements and design through verification, validation, release, and post-market support.
  - listitem: Collaborate with project and development teams to ensure compliance with company procedures, applicable standards, and regulatory requirements.
  - listitem: Provide early quality input on software requirements, architecture, algorithms, code, and technical design reviews.
  - listitem: Review requirements, design outputs, test cases/results, and traceability documentation for completeness, clarity, and compliance.
  - listitem: Support software risk management activities, including SFMEA, hazard analysis, risk mitigation, and verification.
  - listitem: Support verification and validation planning, execution, documentation, defect investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA activities.
  - listitem: Contribute to software configuration management, change control, release readiness, and documentation consistency.
  - listitem: Support internal/external audits and regulatory readiness while monitoring software quality metrics and driving process improvements.
  - listitem: Provide quality input on reliability, cybersecurity, usability, and other software quality considerations throughout development.
- heading "Required Qualifications" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Science, or a related technical field.
  - listitem: 3 to 7 years of experience in software quality, software development, verification and validation, or a related engineering/quality role.
  - listitem: Working knowledge of software development lifecycle activities.
  - listitem: Understanding of design controls, requirements traceability, verification and validation, and risk management.
  - listitem: Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  - listitem: Effective communication skills and ability to work across multiple functions and organizational levels.
  - listitem: Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work on time.
- heading "Preferred Qualifications" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Experience in medical device or other regulated product development environments.
  - listitem: Familiarity with standards and regulations such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, 21 CFR 820, and IEC 60601-1.
  - listitem: Knowledge of Agile development methodology.
  - listitem: Experience with embedded software, mobile applications, or medical device software.
  - listitem: Familiarity with cybersecurity evaluations and how threats can translate to patient safety risks.
  - listitem: Experience supporting audits, inspections, or regulatory submissions.

- heading "Software Test Solutions Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "ADI - Analog Devices" [level=2]
- heading "Valencia or Limerick" [level=2]
- paragraph: Analog Devices Inc. is looking for a Software Test Solutions Engineer to lead test automation solutions and manage stakeholder relationships within their QSS Test Operations group. The role focuses on integrating and supporting test automation infrastructure and continuous integration systems.
- heading "Responsibilities:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Gather and define stakeholder Test Automation requirements
  - listitem: Define project plans for implementing and installing Test Solution application for new and legacy projects
  - listitem: Identify how to integrate into existing CICD systems or recommend implementation of the QSS standard CICD pipeline to support Test Automation
  - listitem: Coordinate with other infrastructure teams to design and configure virtual systems for build and test environments
  - listitem: Troubleshoot issues and solve problems with Test Automation infrastructure, build systems as needed
  - listitem: Assist with configuring and setting up common relational database environments
  - listitem: Support training teams on the use of QSS Test Solution frameworks
  - listitem: Assist with integration of Test Solution applications.
  - listitem: Administering Linux operating systems
  - listitem: Support integration of CI test pipelines
  - listitem: Install and support code coverage tools to capture quality of test automation coverage
  - listitem: May also include assisting with development of test automation infrastructure
  - listitem: Serve as a champion for advancing Test Automation best practices and new methodologies within the organization
- heading "Minimum Qualifications/skills:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: 3 to 5 years of relative experience within software tests with at least 1 of those years in a Project Management related role
  - listitem: A University master’s degree in computer engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering or a related field is required. Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in engineering and equivalent professional experience in the sector will also be considered
  - listitem: Operations Project Management background
  - listitem: Background in managing test automation environments
  - listitem: Experience in software development and testing of code
  - listitem: Strong expertise in DevOps Agile CI/CD implementation
  - listitem: Experience with building infrastructure and tools such as GCOV/GCC, Coverity, Git/Bitbucket, Artifactory, Jira, Visual Studios, etc.
  - listitem: Experience with relational databases, such as SQL or PostgreSQL
  - listitem: Experience with developing and deploying Github actions
  - listitem: Experience with maintaining various scripting languages to build software from scratch, test, and deploy it for a specific use case
  - listitem: Experience with container technologies like Docker
  - listitem: Experience with Linux and cross-platform development
  - listitem: Experience with Python and bash scripting
  - listitem: Experience with C, C++ and Shell Scripting
  - listitem: Excellent analytical skills
- heading "Preferred Qualifications:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: 7+ Years of DevOps experience in managing test infrastructure and with 2 of the years in Project Management
  - listitem: Project Management skills
  - listitem: Exposure to embedded software product development with test background
  - listitem: Experience with Agile methodology
  - listitem: Experience with C#, Python and Java
  - listitem: Experience with non-relational databases such as MongoDB
  - listitem: Experience with time series databases, such as InfluxDB
  - listitem: Experience with visualization tooling, such as Grafana
  - listitem: Maintenance of Docker/Container clusters
  - listitem: Knowledge of hybrid cloud environments
  - listitem: Knowledge of OpenShift and CloudSmith highly desirable

- heading "Ready to level up your career?" [level=3]
- paragraph: Playtech’s Sports team is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Junior QA Engineer who is eager to start and grow their career in a dynamic international environment. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our products by assisting with test execution, identifying issues, and working closely with experienced engineers, developers, and product teams.
- paragraph: To ensure a successful onboarding experience and close collaboration with the team, employees are expected to work from the office five days per week during the first 6 months of probation. Following the probation period, the role transitions to a hybrid working model, with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
- heading "Job Description" [level=3]
- heading "Your influential mission. You will..." [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Contribute to the quality and reliability of Playtech’s Sports products by executing test activities across multiple projects and features
  - listitem: Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and fellow QA engineers to ensure comprehensive test coverage and a seamless user experience
  - listitem: Analyze requirements, create detailed test plans and test cases, and help identify potential risks early in the development cycle
  - listitem: Execute manual testing, investigate system behavior, analyze logs, and document defects with clarity and precision
  - listitem: Support software release activities and contribute to maintaining high product quality standards.
  - listitem: Take ownership of smaller projects and testing initiatives while continuously developing your QA expertise
- heading "Qualifications" [level=3]
- heading "Components for success. You..." [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Hold a BSc degree in Computer Science or a related field
  - listitem: Have a basic understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and QA best practices
  - listitem: Are familiar with concepts such as black-box testing, white-box testing, integration testing, and defect tracking
  - listitem: Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  - listitem: Possess excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  - listitem: Show a genuine willingness to learn and develop new technical skills
  - listitem: Have strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset
  - listitem: Can work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  - listitem: Maintain a positive attitude and a high level of professionalism in a fast-paced environment

- list:
  - listitem: Previous experience in Quality Assurance, software testing, or the gaming industry
  - listitem: Familiarity with bug-tracking and test management tools
  - listitem: Experience writing test cases, test scenarios, or test documentation
  - listitem: Exposure to software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes
  - listitem: Passion for technology, quality engineering, and continuous improvement
  - listitem: Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to build a long-term career in Quality Assurance

- heading "(Senior) Quality Assurance Engineer - Automation" [level=2]
- heading "osapiens" [level=2]
- heading "Madrid, Spain" [level=2]
- paragraph: As a Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the stability, reliability Business Partner Transparency products within the Osapiens HUB platform. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and executing both manual and automated testing strategies, working closely with development teams to foster a strong quality-driven culture from the ground up.
- paragraph: You will perform end-to-end testing across backend integrations, frontend, and mobile. This is an opportunity to work with different frameworks. You will face the challenge of handling multiple tasks and balancing different domains within a team that is committed to supporting your growth. You will also be involved in application testing and in developing automated tests, contributing to the creation of effective strategies to implement automation across various areas of the product.
- heading "Your Responsibilities" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Take full ownership of product quality and reliability, ensuring seamless performance across all features.
  - listitem: Develop and maintain automated UI tests using TypeScript and Playwright to enhance frontend reliability.
  - listitem: Design and execute API tests using Jest, ensuring robust backend validation.
  - listitem: Work closely with development teams to identify, prevent, and resolve quality issues early in the development cycle.
  - listitem: Lead test planning and risk assessments, ensuring that releases are stable, secure, and ready for production.
  - listitem: Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies, helping to evolve our testing framework in an agile environment.
- heading "Your Experience" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: 4+ years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer or SDET, with a solid track record in delivering high‑quality automated testing solutions.
  - listitem: Deep understanding of software testing principles, QA methodologies, and best practices, including strong attention to detail in both documentation and test execution.
  - listitem: Hands‑on experience with web automation, preferably using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  - listitem: Experience with API testing and API automation, ideally using Jest or similar testing frameworks.
  - listitem: Good knowledge of CI/CD pipelines - Azure DevOps/Gitlab/Jenkins or other, including test automation integration, and familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  - listitem: Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying quality gaps and proposing improvements.
  - listitem: Effective communication skills and a collaborative working style when partnering with developers, product managers, and cross‑functional teams.
  - listitem: Experience using AI‑powered tools (e.g., for test generation, code assistance, debugging, exploratory testing, or automation optimization) is considered a strong plus.
  - listitem: Fluent in English (C1+)

- heading "Senior Verification Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "Arm" [level=2]
- heading "Budapest, Hungary" [level=2]
- heading "About the Role" [level=3]
- paragraph: In the Solutions Engineering team, we are building subsystems for various application segments, using the latest IP products from Arm. We are looking for a creative and skilled colleague to join the team and help in the development process of these systems. Would you love a wider exposure across multiple IP products? Do you want an opportunity to work globally with various internal teams to deliver innovative systems? Join our team to help us craft the future products together!
- heading "Responsibilities" [level=3]
- paragraph: As a Hardware engineer, you will be involved in the verification process of IoT, Mobile and Infrastructure subsystems integrating the latest Arm IPs as we are targeting to reach maximum efficiency in terms of power consumption, performance and area while ensuring correct functional behaviour. Your key responsibilities and tasks will include design/verification activities meant to fulfill the project requirements. Collaboration with architecture, design, verification, performance analysis, implementation and various IP is essential as we work together on enabling our partners' success. A mentor will guide your way making sure that your journey in the project and company is a success.
- heading "Essential Skills and Experience" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: You graduated from a University or Engineering School, in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, or other related;
  - listitem: You already have some experience in Hardware or Software development;
  - listitem: Proficiency in both written and spoken English.
- heading "Desirable Skills and Experience" [level=3]
- paragraph: "It is not required to tick all the boxes below, however the following skills can be a big plus:"
- list:
  - listitem: Practical experience of working on microprocessor or complex system designs;
  - listitem: Understanding of design or verification methodologies and techniques;
  - listitem: Hands-on experience with System Verilog UVM or a good understanding of object-oriented programming;
  - listitem: Familiar with embedded C, assembly and compilers;
  - listitem: Knowledge of basic scripting languages, e.g. Perl/TCL/Python;
  - listitem: Experience with Linux, shell scripts and Makefiles;
  - listitem: Knowledge of Verilog or VHDL;
  - listitem: Experience with version control systems such as Git.

- heading "SQA Developer" [level=2]
- heading "Aylo" [level=2]
- heading "Nicosia, Cyprus" [level=2]
- paragraph: As our SQA Developer, you will play a key role in building and maintaining our automated testing infrastructure to ensure the quality and reliability of our ad tech platform. You'll develop automated test scripts, build reusable testing tools, and collaborate closely with our QA and development teams to continuously raise the bar on quality. Beyond automation, you'll also stay connected to the product through hands-on manual testing, helping to translate real user scenarios into robust, scalable test coverage. You'll be joining a team of outgoing individuals who share a great dynamic and are part of a fantastic company culture that promotes flexibility and balance.
- heading "What you'll be doing:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Perform basic SQA development and testing automation following established quality development procedures;
  - listitem: Assist with routine SQA tasks including test script development, automation support, and quality documentation using standard development processes;
  - listitem: Support QA teams with development preparation activities, testing organization, and basic coordination tasks;
  - listitem: Process routine testing requests and maintain accurate QA records while ensuring quality and compliance;
  - listitem: Prepare basic testing reports and development summaries using standard templates and SQA guidelines;
  - listitem: Assist with QA updates by gathering testing data and preparing preliminary analysis for senior staff review;
  - listitem: Monitor SQA development effectiveness during testing processes and document findings for continuous improvement purposes.
- heading "What you'll need to be successful:" [level=3]
- heading "Must haves:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: 2+ years of experience in Automation Testing using Java/Groovy/Python;
  - listitem: 1-3 years of experience in Manual Software Quality Assurance;
  - listitem: Experience with bug tracking software, such as Jira;
  - listitem: Good understanding of Katalon, TestProject, Selenium;
  - listitem: Good understanding of Mobile and Desktop browser testing & browser support;
  - listitem: Experience with Git Repository Management Tools(Git Lab, Bitbucket etc.);
  - listitem: Experience working with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLabs);
  - listitem: Knowledge of multiple scripting or programming language;
  - listitem: Experience with API Testing;
  - listitem: Experience in Cross Browser Automation and Mobile Emulators (e.g. BrowserStack);
  - listitem: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, easy-to-understand language.
- heading "Nice to haves:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Demonstrated judgment reviewing and correcting AI-generated code;
  - listitem: Evidence of having restructured workflows around AI, beyond occasional use;
  - listitem: Hands-on experience building or configuring AI agents and automated workflows.

- heading "Staff Design Verification Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "AMD - Advanced Micro Devices" [level=2]
- heading "Cambridge, United Kingdom" [level=2]
- heading "THE ROLE:" [level=3]
- paragraph: As part of AMD's networking silicon team, you will work on next-generation network processors and SmartNIC technologies, driving verification of complex packet-processing, control-plane, and system-level features. You will leverage automation, data-driven methodologies, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve verification productivity, accelerate debug, enhance coverage analysis, and help deliver high-quality silicon.
- paragraph: This role provides the opportunity to work at the intersection of networking silicon, advanced verification methodologies, and AI-driven engineering productivity. You will help shape how modern verification teams leverage automation and intelligent workflows to improve quality, scalability, and time-to-market.
- heading "THE PERSON:" [level=3]
- paragraph: You have a passion for modern, complex processor architectures, digital design, and verification. You are a collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and experience working with engineers across multiple sites and time zones. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, are eager to learn, and are motivated to tackle challenging technical problems.
- heading "KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, and firmware engineers to understand new features and define verification requirements;
  - listitem: Build comprehensive verification plans that account for interactions across hardware, firmware, software, and system-level use cases;
  - listitem: Develop directed and constrained-random tests, verification environments, and automation infrastructure;
  - listitem: Estimate verification effort and identify required enhancements to verification environments and methodologies;
  - listitem: Debug test failures to determine root cause and work with RTL and firmware engineers to resolve design defects;
  - listitem: Review and drive functional and code coverage closure through targeted test development and analysis;
  - listitem: Contribute to advanced verification methodologies spanning simulation, emulation, and data-driven analytics to accelerate silicon quality and release readiness;
  - listitem: Develop automation solutions and leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve verification efficiency, debug productivity, coverage analysis, and test development;
  - listitem: Drive continuous improvement of verification processes through scripting, automation, and emerging AI technologies.
- heading "PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Proficient in IP-level ASIC verification;
  - listitem: Strong experience with UVM testbenches and SystemVerilog;
  - listitem: Proficient in debugging RTL and firmware using industry-standard simulation tools;
  - listitem: Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, C, and C++;
  - listitem: Experience developing UVM-based verification frameworks, reusable components, and verification methodologies;
  - listitem: Experience with Python, Perl, Shell, Makefiles, or similar scripting languages;
  - listitem: Familiarity with data analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices;
  - listitem: Experience applying AI/ML-assisted tools to verification, debug, coverage closure, or engineering productivity workflows;
  - listitem: Experience using Python-based frameworks and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering efficiency;
  - listitem: Good understanding of SystemC and TLM; related experience is a plus;
  - listitem: Exposure to networking, packet processing, Ethernet, SmartNIC, or networking processor architectures is highly desirable;
  - listitem: Exposure to leadership and mentorship is an asset.
- heading "ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- heading "Automation QA Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "Bang & Olufsen" [level=2]
- heading "Lyngby or Struer, Denmark" [level=2]
- paragraph: As an Automation QA Engineer with Wireless and RF-protocols focus, you will join our QA Automation team in Kongens Lyngby or Struer, contributing to the development of automated testing solutions for our product systems, help ensure the quality and reliability of the experiences we create, and become our go-to person for how connectivity is verified.
- heading "Key responsibilities" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Develop, maintain, and extend Python-based automated test solutions using Labgrid and hardware-in-the-loop environments to ensure test coverage, reliability, and scalability;
  - listitem: Design, execute, and maintain integration and system-level verification tests for Bluetooth, BLE, WiFi, and LAN connectivity features across our embedded software platform;
  - listitem: Utilize knowledge of Software QA principles to perform requirements analysis, refine acceptance criteria, identify and help overcome testability constraints for software under development;
  - listitem: Build and maintain test infrastructure, including hardware test jigs, instrumentation, networking equipment, and CI/CD integrations using GitHub Actions and distributed test environments;
  - listitem: Investigate, reproduce, and root-cause connectivity and communication issues using protocol analysis, packet captures, and RF-level debugging, converting recurring findings into automated regression tests;
  - listitem: Collaborate closely with software development, manual QA, and customer validation teams throughout the product lifecycle, from early prototypes to final verification;
  - listitem: Provide transparency on test progress, quality metrics, KPIs, and system maturity through documentation, reporting, and stakeholder communication;
  - listitem: Act as the internal subject matter expert within wireless and Bluetooth connectivity testing while supporting continuous improvements to our testing capabilities and quality processes.
- heading "What you bring" [level=3]
- paragraph: You are either recently graduated or have a few years of professional experience and are passionate about software quality and automation. You understand how wireless and Bluetooth connectivity works and you are curious enough to keep digging where it doesn't. You thrive in technically complex environments and enjoy transforming ambiguous requirements into structured, traceable, and effective test coverage.
- heading "Moreover, you bring:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: A relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar, or equivalent practical experience;
  - listitem: Experience with software development in Python or similar language focusing on writing clean, scalable, and well-documented code;
  - listitem: Strong knowledge of Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi, networking protocols, and connectivity testing for embedded or connected products;
  - listitem: Experience designing integration and system-level tests, ideally including hardware-in-the-loop testing and automation frameworks;
  - listitem: Familiarity with modern software development practices and tools including Agile, DevOps, Git & GitHub, CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Docker, and infrastructure automation tools like Ansible;
  - listitem: Knowledge of software test management & reporting, shift-left and continuous testing practices for systems engineering;
  - listitem: Strong collaboration and communication skills, curiosity for new technologies, and fluency in English.

- heading "Software Development Engineer in Test" [level=2]
- heading "EA - Electronic Arts" [level=2]
- heading "Bucharest, Romania" [level=2]
- paragraph: We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test to join our DICE Quality Engineering team, located in studios across Sweden, US, Canada, and Romania. In Bucharest, the team supports the latest Battlefield products.
- paragraph: Through close partnership with Game Developers and Quality Verification teams, Engineers aim to improve the player experience by delivering technical solutions that reduce testing time, enhance productivity and improve the quality verification and game development lifecycle.
- paragraph: As a SDET you will report to an Engineering Manager based in Bucharest while partnering with members from all DICE locations.
- heading "Expectations:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: You will architect, and scale, reliable and maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch across Front End, World Levels, Backend and API layers.
  - listitem: You will establish the long-term technical vision for test automation tools, libraries, and infrastructure across the Quality Engineering department.
  - listitem: You will influence system architecture early on to promote "shift-left" testing methodologies, ensuring you bake testability into the design phase.
  - listitem: You will architect and improve the integration of automated test into CI/CD pipelines, maximizing build speed and reliable feedback loops.
  - listitem: You will lead non-functional testing strategies, including advanced performance engineering, load testing, security vulnerability scanning, and chaos engineering (stress testing).
  - listitem: You will establish the foundation allowing DICE test automation to evolve from a "Script-First" to an "AI-Native" approach.
  - listitem: You will develop adversarial testing frameworks to detect biases, edge cases, flaws in ML and Generative AI models employed within our CI infrastructure.
  - listitem: You will research and lead the development of “Self-Healing” auto-tests by injecting Generative AI into the runtime execution loop.
  - listitem: You will be the ultimate technical escalation point for critical automation failures, blocking pipeline issues, or production quality incidents.
  - listitem: You will partner with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, and Product Owners to agree on organization goals delivery.
  - listitem: You will mentor mid-level Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)s and Test Designers, evolving their coding, framework design, and engineering skills.
- heading "Requirements:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Minimum of 5+ years of experience in a Software Engineering, DevOps, or Software Development Engineer in Test role, with experience architecting automation frameworks from concept to production.
  - listitem: Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go).
  - listitem: Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Jenkins) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  - listitem: Understanding of complex, distributed cloud systems and identify structural integration risks.
  - listitem: Capability to explain technical quality risks to both technical developers and non-technical partners or product leaders.

- heading "Test Automation Specialist" [level=2]
- heading "Uni Systems" [level=2]
- heading "Brussels, Belgium" [level=2]
- heading "Description" [level=3]
- paragraph: At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a Test Automation Specialist to join our UniQue team.
- heading "What will you be doing in this role?" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Design, preparation and monitoring of automated tests.
  - listitem: Contribution to the development of a plan to integrate automated testing within the testing process.
  - listitem: Evaluation of the tools and technology for automation best fit to the project within the DevSecOps approach.
  - listitem: Creation of an approach and methodology for building a test automation architecture.
  - listitem: Design and development (new or modified) of test automation solutions that meet the business needs and apply continuous integration technologies, especially targeting backend/web service-based interfaces.
  - listitem: Enabling the transition of testing from a manual to an automated approach.
  - listitem: Creation of automated test reporting and metrics collection.
  - listitem: Assistance during relevant parts of testing, analysis, technical documentation, deployment, evaluation and reporting.
- heading "Requirements" [level=3]
- heading "What will you be bringing to the team?" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor degree in IT and years 11 of experience in IT.
  - listitem: At least 1 year of specific expertise in Java.
  - listitem: At least 1 year of specific expertise in Web Services.
  - listitem: Good knowledge of test automation technologies, tools and techniques.
  - listitem: Experience in the creation of test automation solutions involving own programming.
  - listitem: Good knowledge of Test Management and Defect Tracking tools.
  - listitem: Experience in the test data management.
  - listitem: "Experience with scripting and programming: Java, Groovy."
  - listitem: Experience working with SQL and database servers.
  - listitem: Knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture.
  - listitem: Knowledge of Relational DBMS.
  - listitem: "Experience using continuous integration techniques and tools: Bamboo, Git."
  - listitem: "Experience using testing tools: SoapUI, Postman, Selenium WebDriver."
  - listitem: "Experience working with containerisation tools: Docker."
  - listitem: Familiarity with interoperability technology (e.g., web services, message-oriented middleware).
  - listitem: Fluent in English at least at a level B1.

- heading "Senior Software Development Engineer in Test" [level=2]
- heading "Unity Technologies" [level=2]
- heading "Vilnius, Lithuania" [level=2]
- heading "The opportunity" [level=3]
- paragraph: We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with Android expertise to join the Automation and Tooling Team. Our team consists of Software Development Engineers in Test spread across two locations in Europe, working collaboratively across sites and time zones.
- paragraph: You will join a team responsible for the test infrastructure underpinning Unity's continuous integration. The team builds and maintains CI pipelines across a wide range of platforms - desktop, mobile, consoles, and embedded systems - ensuring that Unity's engine and editor are thoroughly tested before every release.
- paragraph: You will work closely with the team's existing Android platform owner to strengthen Unity's Android test infrastructure - spanning physical device fleets, emulator pipelines, and the tooling that ties them into Unity's CI system. You will contribute to the technical direction for Android CI, collaborate with development and platform teams across Unity, and help ensure Android test pipelines run reliably across all release streams.
- heading "What you'll be doing" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Working alongside the current Android platform owner to expand and strengthen Android test infrastructure across Unity's CI system
  - listitem: Contributing to the design and maintenance of CI pipelines for Android devices and emulators, ensuring coverage across Android versions, GPU vendors, and device form factors
  - listitem: Participating in Android device fleet strategy - evaluating new devices, planning upgrades, handling device lifecycle and compatibility
  - listitem: Building and improving tools and frameworks for Android test automation, including ADB-based device interaction, emulator management, and test execution
  - listitem: Troubleshooting complex, failing CI scenarios across code and infrastructure, including device-specific issues, driver compatibility, and platform-level regressions
  - listitem: Driving engineering best practices within the team and contributing to cross-team technical decisions
  - listitem: Working cross-team and cross-site with development teams, graphics teams, and platform teams to coordinate test infrastructure changes
  - listitem: Mentoring less experienced team members and contributing to code quality through thorough code reviews
  - listitem: Utilizing AI tools such as Claude to boost productivity in analysis, automation, and problem-solving
- heading "What we're looking for" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Experience with Unity and its usage
  - listitem: Knowledge of Unity test frameworks and testing methodologies
  - listitem: Knowledge of Unity-supported platforms, with depth in Android
  - listitem: Knowledge of Android phones, including ADB connectivity, device provisioning, emulator configuration, Android SDK/NDK tooling, and device fleet management
  - listitem: Experience with CI/CD systems, for example Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar
  - listitem: Programming experience in C#, with secondary experience in Python
  - listitem: Experience with or knowledge of AI tools usage, such as Claude, for development productivity
  - listitem: A track record of contributing to a technical domain and driving improvements independently
  - listitem: An analytical mindset with the ability to debug issues across code and infrastructure layers
  - listitem: A team player who thrives in a collaborative, cross*site environment
  - listitem: An agile mindset with a structured approach to tracking work, for example using Jira
- heading "You might also have" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Experience with Android emulator infrastructure (AVD configuration, virtualization, custom images)
  - listitem: Experience working with Android Studio/Google Firebase Lab
  - listitem: Familiarity with scripting in Bash or PowerShell
  - listitem: Experience with development supporting tools such as Git, code review workflows, and project management tools as Jira
  - listitem: Experience mentoring engineers or driving technical standards within a team

- heading "ams OSRAM" [level=2]
- heading "Pavia, Italy" [level=2]
- heading "Your tasks" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Project planning, quotes for target test times and development costs and efforts
  - listitem: Development of test concepts in cooperation with Design, Customer and Suppliers
  - listitem: Test ICs on Wafer Level and Package Level
  - listitem: Hardware development to adapt existing test platforms to the test requirements of the products
  - listitem: Design of test interface circuitry (loadboard) and probecard for wafer level testing
  - listitem: Development of test software for Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) using structural and high-level programming languages
  - listitem: Industrialisation of the test solution and transfer to production with clearly defined stability and repeatability criteria’s
  - listitem: Close cooperation with the product development to ensure testability of the IC-products in a very early design stages and with test support, product engineering, production and quality
  - listitem: Contribution to new test methods and test development Know-how as well as continuous contribution to workflow and process improvement
- heading "Who we are looking for" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Technical Education (preferred Technical University) in the areas of Electronics, Measurement Engineering
  - listitem: Experience with High level Programming Languages like C, C++, Unison
  - listitem: Knowledge in Hardware- and Circuit Design and strong DFT Knowledge
  - listitem: Familiarity with automotive ecosystems and standards like AEC-Q100, TS16949 and ISO 26262
  - listitem: Experience with Automatic Test Equipment for Semiconductors is advantageous (Teradyne Ultraflex / Ultraflex + /, Cohu DiamondX preferred)
  - listitem: Proven understanding in analog and digital circuit development, design for test and semiconductor technologies
  - listitem: Data analysis, statistics of silicon results and debugging
  - listitem: Innovative approach to optimize test program efficiency and effectiveness
  - listitem: Teamplayer who enjoys working in and with multicultural teams
  - listitem: Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

- heading "Aptiv" [level=2]
- heading "Braga, Portugal" [level=2]
- heading "Job Responsibilities:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Work on test software, hardware, and application specific tooling for assigned product programs
  - listitem: Develop and optimize manufacturing functional tests (electrical)
  - listitem: Develop statement of work (SOW) for test and programming processes/equipment
  - listitem: Support kick-off meetings and MSD workshops with/in the PML for the assigned project
  - listitem: Enforce proper requirements management for the assigned test process
  - listitem: Facilitate test coverage analysis process, ensuring adequate test coverage for the assigned test process, request design changes in case test coverage issues in early design phase
  - listitem: Utilize 6-Sigma for Test Statistical Analysis Methods to optimize CPK performance of parametric electrical tests
  - listitem: Track needed test equipment/tools, ensure availability of needed material for all equipment/tool development
  - listitem: Perform test equipment buy-off at suppliers, drive capability studies, strain measurement, create list of key parameters to be transferred to quality plan
  - listitem: Work out proper documentation of the assigned test process, respect the APTIV processes and procedures accordingly
  - listitem: Provide equipment training to PML test engineers, latest after PV
  - listitem: Participate in escalation meetings on program management level on demand
  - listitem: Support global Test Site team for agreed/defined tasks for post series test processes
- heading "Qualifications:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor degree or similar with technical education
  - listitem: "Proficient software development skills in one or more of the following software languages: National Instruments LabView, NI LabWindows CVI, NI TestStand, C++, C"
  - listitem: Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, LVDS, Flex-Ray, Broad@Reach and flashing concepts of memory devices
  - listitem: Knowledge in SSFT and statistical methods
  - listitem: Good problem solving capability
  - listitem: Ability to work and live a global network environment
  - listitem: Energetic, self-motivated, and proactive work style
  - listitem: Business fluent English

- heading "Software Development Engineer in Test" [level=2]
- heading "Medtronic" [level=2]
- heading "London, United Kingdom" [level=2]
- heading "A Day in the Life" [level=3]
- paragraph: As a Software Development Engineer in Test you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our software development lifecycle by designing and building automated test solutions that ensure the reliability, safety, and performance of our embedded and connected hardware platforms used in the operating room. This role focuses on testing device software, firmware integrations, and hardware-software interaction, rather than web or mobile applications.
- paragraph: You’ll collaborate closely with engineering teams to embed quality at every stage, leverage modern automation frameworks, and help drive continuous improvement in our testing practices. If you are passionate about developing robust automation and elevating product quality through software, we want to hear from you.
- heading "Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and tools for device software, focusing on scalable, reusable solutions.
  - listitem: Collaborate with software engineers to define test scenarios, testable architectures, and drive quality through code.
  - listitem: Develop, implement and execute advanced test automation strategies for embedded, edge, and device-integrated systems (Android AOSP, Linux-based edge devices, IoT gateways), including validation of device drivers, connectivity modules, and firmware updates.
  - listitem: Analyse requirements and develop comprehensive test plans and protocols for a range of technologies, including service APIs (REST, IPC), WebUI, and over-the-air updates.
  - listitem: Contribute to continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with automated quality gates.
  - listitem: Generate and maintain technical documentation, standards, and best practices for test, automation and quality engineering.
  - listitem: Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and systems engineers to validate device performance, connectivity, and stability under real-world operating conditions.
  - listitem: Must be able to commute frequently to London-based office; 3~5 days per week onsite.
- heading "Required Knowledge and Experience" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent international degree).
  - listitem: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software automation and test development, or advanced degree with 2+ years relevant experience.
  - listitem: Strong proficiency in software development for test automation (Python, Java, or equivalent).
  - listitem: Hands-on experience with manual test management tools and test automation frameworks (Selenium, Appium, Espresso, etc.).
  - listitem: Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  - listitem: Device operating systems (Android, Linux).
  - listitem: Service-oriented architecture (SoA), APIs (REST, IPC).
  - listitem: Hands-on experience testing embedded or connected hardware devices, preferably involving edge computing or IoT systems.
  - listitem: Strong understanding of hardware-software interaction, debugging logs, and analysing system-level behaviour.
  - listitem: Familiarity with firmware validation, board bring-up testing, or similar.
  - listitem: Web-based interfaces, Internet-connected devices, OTA updates.
  - listitem: Highly technical, hands-on, and passionate about product quality.
  - listitem: Demonstrated ability to design and implement automated solutions, not just execute manual tests.
  - listitem: Self-starter, autonomous, and able to lead initiatives independently.
- paragraph: Experience with embedded device software development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, device connectivity (USB, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth), and video streaming or imaging devices. Familiarity with medical device standards (IEC 62304) and safety-critical testing is a strong plus.
